name: Diploma Automobile Engineering
title: Diploma in Automobile Engineering
intro: The automobile engineering diploma roadmap: polytechnic admission, vehicle systems papers, workshop training and automotive careers.
glance: Job or lateral entry to B.Tech

phases.title: Class 10 and eligibility
phases.summary: Class 10 pass with Maths and Science is the standard requirement.
points: Most states ask for a Class 10 pass with Mathematics and Science; some accept a Class 12 pass or ITI route for lateral entry into the second year.
Minimum marks (often 35–50%) are set by the state technical education board.
Choose a branch by interest: fit with the work you imagine doing matters more than rank in a counselling list.
Automobile diploma students benefit from comfort with Maths, drawing and practical work.

phases.title: Polytechnic admission cycle
phases.summary: State polytechnic entrance tests or merit lists with counselling.
points: Register on your state’s Directorate of Technical Education (DTE) or polytechnic admission portal; applications usually open from May to June.
Some states use an entrance test (for example Delhi CET or state-specific tests); others admit purely on Class 10 marks.
Counselling rounds allot a branch and college by rank and choice; verify AICTE approval before choosing.
Confirm admission by paying the fee and submitting documents within the deadline.

phases.title: Year 1: engineering foundations
phases.summary: Maths, science, drawing and workshop basics.
points: Core papers: Engineering Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Engineering Graphics and Workshop Practice.
You also take communication skills, computer basics and environmental studies.
Workshop and lab practice teach hand and machine skills from day one.
Internal tests, practical exams and a semester exam decide marks.

phases.title: Year 2–3: branch subjects and projects
phases.summary: Specialised papers, labs and a final project.
points: Year 2: Thermodynamics, Automotive Engines, Automotive Transmission, Strength of Materials and Manufacturing Processes.
Year 3: Vehicle Maintenance, Automotive Electrical and Electronics, Chassis and Suspension, Hybrid and Electric Vehicles and Automobile Testing.
A final-year project and presentation are required for the diploma.
Tools and software you should learn: AutoCAD, vehicle diagnostic tools, scan tools and basics of EV systems.
facts: AutoCAD, vehicle diagnostic tools, scan tools and basics of EV systems

phases.title: Industrial training and apprenticeship
phases.summary: Industrial exposure is part of the curriculum.
points: Train at an automobile service centre, assembly plant or garage to learn diagnostics, servicing and quality checks.
Apply for apprenticeships through the Apprenticeship India portal and the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) for graduate and diploma apprentices.
A training certificate and logbook are usually submitted to the college.
Apprenticeship experience improves campus and government job chances.

phases.title: Jobs and upgrading your qualification
phases.summary: Start work, appear for government exams or move to a degree.
points: Jobs and roles: service engineer, workshop supervisor, quality inspector and technician in dealerships, automakers and component suppliers.
Government jobs: Junior Engineer through SSC JE, RRB JE and state PSC/department recruitment.
After the diploma you can take lateral entry into B.Tech/B.E. Automobile or Mechanical Engineering (second year).
Short certification courses add skills that employers value.
facts: SSC JE, RRB JE, state exams
